title: Analyst I Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description:**

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain robust backend services that power our applications. In this role, you will work extensively with Java, Spring Boot, and the Spring Framework to create scalable and secure solutions that integrate seamlessly with frontend applications through RESTful APIs.

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of backend development, from designing APIs to optimizing database performance and ensuring application security. Working with both NoSQL and SQL databases such as MongoDB and MSSQL, you will contribute to schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies that keep applications running efficiently.

This role offers the opportunity to collaborate closely with DevOps teams and gain exposure to cloud technologies, particularly AWS services, while contributing to performance engineering and application monitoring efforts that ensure high-quality, reliable software delivery.

### **Essential Job Functions**

* Develop and maintain backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Framework.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrate with frontend applications.
* Work with MongoDB, MSSQL, and other NoSQL/SQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies.
* Optimize application performance and ensure adherence to security best practices.
* Test and debug APIs using Postman.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to support deployment and infrastructure practices.
* Apply performance engineering techniques and conduct application monitoring and optimization.
* Utilize AWS services such as S3, EC2, Lambda, IAM, API Gateway, and ECS where applicable.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Experience with REST API development using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
* Experience with Node JS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Proficiency with Postman and GIT.
* Proficient in using IDEs like Eclipse.
* Experience with MongoDB and MSSQL, including schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies.

### **Other Qualifications**

* Basic knowledge of AWS services (S3, EC2, Lambda, IAM, API Gateway, ECS) is a plus.
* Familiarity with performance engineering, application monitoring, and optimization.
* Knowledge of AWS common services and DevOps practices is a plus.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Job Summary

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design, build, and operate distributed, microservices-based applications that power Clearwater's platform. You will write high-quality, well-tested code, solve complex problems with your teammates, and help mentor newer engineers. Success in this role requires strong problem-solving, clear communication, excellent coding ability, and a collaborative approach.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, build, deploy, and maintain quality code that is simple, well-structured, clear, and well-tested.
* Break down and solve complex problems that require research or collaboration.
* Build and evolve microservices and APIs, with attention to performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
* Apply multiple levels of automated testing (unit, integration, contract, end-to-end).
* Initiate design and feature discussions, advocating for improvements in software quality.
* Coordinate with other teams to ensure successful integration of software applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents quickly and effectively, and participate in on-call.
* Mentor new and less-experienced team members.
* Understand and address customer needs and issues with empathy and timeliness.
* Communicate effectively regardless of medium, audience, or timing.
* Perform other reasonable duties as required by management.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* 4+ years of software development experience in Java or another typed, object-oriented backend language (e.g., Python, Go).
* Experience building services using microservices and distributed-system patterns (REST/gRPC APIs, messaging).
* Experience with a public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD, and production monitoring.
* Working knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL data stores.
* Strong command of automated testing and software engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and good documentation habits.
* Commitment to continuous learning, client satisfaction, and teamwork in a SaaS environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Exposure to AI/ML or LLM-based features, or interest in applying AI to engineering workflows.
* Experience with containers and Kubernetes, or infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Experience with event streaming (Kafka, SQS, etc.) and observability tooling.
* Familiarity with financial services or investment data.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build distributed, microservices-based applications that power Clearwater's platform [and core investment records]. You will provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and drive complex systems from design through production. Success in this role requires strong problem-solving, clear communication, excellent coding ability, and a collaborative approach.

**About the Team**
------------------

Our team builds and operates scalable, resilient microservices and distributed applications that serve Clearwater clients. We work in a cloud-native environment and partner closely with product and client-facing teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide technical leadership and strategic direction for the team.
* Lead the design, implementation, documentation, deployment, and adoption of scalable, resilient distributed systems and microservices.
* Design well-factored APIs and event-driven integrations between services, with attention to performance, fault tolerance, and backward compatibility.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and observability across services, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Break down quarterly deliverables into well-organized stories, weaving in reliability, scalability, security, and performance.
* Mentor less-experienced engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and guidance.
* Work with product and clients to uncover internal and external user needs.
* Track and communicate team metrics (delivery, quality, operational health).
* Get proactively involved in urgent issues and propose effective solutions; own on-call and operational excellence.
* Take on unowned work that improves team velocity and quality.
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, and evaluate their fit.
* Perform other reasonable duties as required by management.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of enterprise software development in Java or another backend language (e.g., Python, Go).
* Experience designing and implementing distributed systems using microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Professional experience running production systems on a public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers, CI/CD, and observability.
* Strong data modeling skills and experience with relational and NoSQL data stores.
* Experience with APIs (REST/gRPC), messaging/streaming (Kafka, SQS, etc.), and designing for scalability and resilience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and strong documentation habits.
* Commitment to continuous learning, client satisfaction, and teamwork in a SaaS environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Exposure to AI/ML or LLM-based features (RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering) or interest in applying AI to engineering workflows.
* Familiarity with financial services, investment accounting, or fixed-income data.
* Experience with data governance, privacy, and regulatory/compliance requirements.
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and Kubernetes experience.
* Track record of technical mentorship and leading cross-team initiatives.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
WritingJob Description: Software Test Engineer / QA EngineerJob Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and quality-driven **Software Test Engineer / QA Engineer** to ensure the functionality, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise software applications. The candidate will collaborate with developers, technical leads, product teams, business analysts, and UI/UX designers to identify defects, validate application workflows, improve test coverage, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

The role involves manual testing, API testing, database validation, test automation, performance testing, and software quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities1. Manual and Functional Testing

* Analyze business requirements and technical specifications to prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate application workflows, user interfaces, forms, reports, and business rules.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Ensure test coverage across positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios.
* Conduct GUI testing and backend testing to verify application functionality and data accuracy.
* Perform user acceptance testing (UAT) support and release validation.

2. API and Database Testing

* Test REST APIs using Postman or similar API testing tools.
* Validate API requests, responses, HTTP status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Perform database testing and data validation using SQL and PostgreSQL.
* Verify data consistency, integrity, and accuracy across application modules.
* Test integrations with third-party applications and enterprise systems.
* Identify API and database-related issues and coordinate with development teams for resolution.

3. Test Automation

* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
* Automate repetitive functional and regression test cases to improve testing efficiency.
* Maintain reusable test scripts and automation frameworks.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation based on application requirements and testing priorities.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
* Collaborate with developers to improve test coverage and reduce manual testing effort.

4. Performance, Security, and Quality Assurance

* Support performance and load testing using JMeter or similar tools.
* Evaluate application responsiveness, stability, and performance under different workloads.
* Validate authentication, authorization, access controls, and session management.
* Identify potential application security vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation with development teams.
* Apply relevant security testing practices, including awareness of the OWASP Top 10.
* Participate in defect triage, root-cause analysis, and release-readiness reviews.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality assessment documentation.

5. Team Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, technical leads, and UI/UX designers.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and sprint retrospectives.
* Support UAT, production validation, and release testing activities.
* Maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, defect logs, and other QA documentation.
* Track testing progress and communicate risks, blockers, and quality concerns to stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and quality standards.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in software testing or quality assurance; the stated experience range is **2–7 years**, subject to confirmation.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.
* Hands-on experience in manual, functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Practical experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Knowledge of SQL and database testing, preferably with PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Understanding of defect tracking, test documentation, and root-cause analysis.
* Knowledge of performance testing, security testing, and CI/CD workflows is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum development methodologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing activities.

Required Technical Skills

* **Manual Testing:** Functional, Regression, Integration, Smoke, Sanity, End-to-End, GUI, and Backend Testing
* **API Testing:** Postman, REST APIs, Request/Response Validation, Authentication, and Authorization
* **Database Testing:** SQL, PostgreSQL, Data Validation, and Data Integrity
* **Automation Testing:** Selenium, Playwright, Cypress
* **Performance Testing:** JMeter, Load Testing, and Performance Testing
* **Security Testing:** Access Control Validation, Session Management, and OWASP Top 10 Awareness
* **Programming Languages:** Python, Java, JavaScript
* **Development Tools:** Git, Docker, CI/CD
* **Test Management:** Jira, Defect Tracking, Test Case Design, and Test Documentation
* **Methodologies:** SDLC, STLC, Agile, Scrum, UAT, and Root Cause Analysis

Job Details

* **Job Title:** Software Test Engineer / QA Engineer
* **Experience:** 2–7 Years (to be confirmed)
* **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field
* **Job Domain:** Software Testing and Quality Assurance
* **Core Focus:** Manual Testing, API Testing, Database Testing, Automation, Performance, and Security
* **Work Environment:** Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, product, and technical teams

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

09

**The Role:** Backend Java Software Developer

**The Team**

A full-scale microservices transformation of the S&P Global’s Financial Risk Analytics product, pre-AI, was expected to require a large pool of technology roles across architecture, engineering, platform, security, operations, and delivery.

For the initial FRA prototype transformation, we want to stand up a lean, generative-AI enabled transformation squad with a focused team structure sized to deliver a validated microservices foundation.

The objective is to establish an agile technology transformation group to design and deliver a commercially aligned, targeted microservices architecture for the FRA platform, prioritizing measurable business outcomes and rapid learnings.

  

**Responsibilities and Impact:**

**Backend Engineer (Microservices Transformation)**
---------------------------------------------------

* Play a central role in building the organisation’s next-generation digital platform, developing microservices and backend components that power interactive and near-real-time customer experiences.
* Design and deliver high-quality domain microservices, REST/ GraphQL APIs, and event-driven integrations that enable scalable, decoupled, and future-ready systems.
* Engineer robust asynchronous workflows and event consumers/producers, helping create resilient services that perform reliably in complex distributed environments.
* Own the design and optimisation of service-owned data stores, supporting performance, scalability, and the successful migration of data from legacy monolithic platforms.
* Drive engineering excellence through unit testing, integration testing, performance tuning, and active code review, ensuring every release meets high standards of quality and maintainability.
* Contribute to operational confidence by monitoring live services, resolving incidents, and continuously improving observability to support secure, stable, and high-performing production systems.
  

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

**Basic Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.
* 5 to 9 years of work experience developing backend applications and microservices using **Java and Spring Boot** .
* Generative AI Development & Integration (Microservices and APIs)
* Scala, Java / Spring Boot and/ or .NET and / or Python
* SQL / NoSQL/ Cassandra/ HBase/ Spark/ Yarn
* Docker
* Git

**Key soft skills**
-------------------

* **Collaborative problem-solving** — Success in a microservices environment depends on working effectively across engineering, product, platform, and architecture teams. This role needs someone who can solve issues collectively, contribute constructively in design discussions, and build strong technical partnerships.
* **Ownership and accountability** — The strongest candidates take responsibility for service quality end to end, from build and test through to production support. They are proactive, dependable, and committed to resolving issues rather than handing them off.
* **Adaptability and learning agility** — Modernisation programs evolve quickly, especially when integrating with legacy platforms and near-real-time systems. This role requires someone who can absorb new domain knowledge fast, adapt to changing priorities, and remain effective in a fast-moving environment.
* **Attention to quality and operational discipline** — Building backend services is not just about writing code; it requires a mindset of precision, reliability, and continuous improvement. The individual should care deeply about testing, performance, observability, and building services that are resilient in production.
  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**

**Additional key qualifications for the job**
---------------------------------------------

* Kubernetes
* Big data technology(Spark, Hadoop etc)
* Event streaming
* Cloud-native development

**Additional soft skills**
--------------------------

* **Systems thinking** — In Kubernetes, messaging, and event-streaming environments, issues rarely sit in one component. Engineers need to understand how services, containers, infrastructure, queues, events, and data flows interact so they can anticipate downstream impact, design more resilient solutions, and troubleshoot effectively across the whole system rather than just their own code.
* **Clear technical communication** — Cloud-native and event-driven architectures create more service boundaries, contracts, and operational dependencies. Engineers must communicate clearly with platform teams, other service owners, and product stakeholders to avoid misunderstanding around APIs, event schemas, ownership, deployment changes, and incident response.
* **Adaptability and continuous learning** — Kubernetes, cloud-native practices, and distributed integration patterns evolve quickly, and real-world implementations often differ from ideal architecture. The role needs someone who can learn fast, absorb new patterns, and adjust to changing tooling, operating models, and migration realities without losing delivery momentum.
* **Operational composure and resilience** — Distributed systems fail in more complex ways: delayed messages, replay issues, scaling problems, noisy alerts, and intermittent production faults. Engineers need to stay calm under pressure, work methodically through ambiguity, and make sound decisions during incidents to protect service reliability and business continuity.

title: Backend Developer
description:
**Backend Developer / Data Engineer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses operating across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our work spans regulatory compliance, product safety, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship, brand protection and technology\-enabled compliance solutions across international markets including the UK, USA, India, Europe, GCC/UAE and other global markets.

As our technology and digital capabilities continue to grow, we are looking for a **Backend Developer / Data Engineer** to join our India\-based technology team and help develop reliable systems, data infrastructure and backend services that support our internal operations and technology platforms.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving backend applications, APIs, databases and data pipelines used across GCRS technology platforms and internal systems.

The role combines **backend software development and data engineering**, making it suitable for someone who enjoys building robust systems while also working with structured data, integrations, automation and reporting.

You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

This is a hands\-on role in a growing environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, development standards, automation and the improvement of our overall technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services
* Develop secure and reliable APIs and integrations
* Build and maintain databases and data models
* Develop data pipelines for collecting, transforming and processing information
* Integrate internal systems and third\-party services through APIs
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-documented code
* Optimise backend performance, database queries and system reliability
* Develop automated processes for data handling and operational workflows
* Support the development of reporting and analytics infrastructure
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity
* Identify and resolve backend and data\-related issues
* Conduct testing, debugging and performance improvements
* Work with frontend developers to support application functionality
* Collaborate with AI and technology teams where backend or data infrastructure is required
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation
* Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of applications
* Monitor systems and investigate technical issues
* Follow appropriate security and data\-protection practices
* Contribute to technical architecture and development standards
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation and efficiency

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical and comfortable working across backend development and data.

You should enjoy solving problems, understanding how systems work and building reliable solutions rather than simply completing individual coding tasks.

You will need to be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with other technology and business teams.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in backend development, software engineering or data engineering
* Strong knowledge of at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js or similar
* Strong understanding of databases and SQL
* Experience developing APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of data structures and data modelling
* Experience working with relational databases
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Good understanding of software development principles
* Experience with Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of application security and data protection
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to document technical work clearly
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desirable Experience**

* Python\-based data engineering and development of data processing pipelines.
* PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational database technologies.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Docker for application containerization and deployment.
* Data warehouses, business intelligence systems or analytics platforms.
* Automation and workflow tools used for streamlining data and operational processes.
* AI/ML systems and their integration with data engineering workflows.
* Handling large, complex or high\-volume datasets.
* SaaS, consultancy, technology or professional services environments.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Developed and maintained reliable backend services
* Improved the performance and stability of existing systems
* Established effective data pipelines and database structures
* Delivered APIs and integrations required by the business
* Improved data quality and accessibility
* Reduced manual data\-processing requirements
* Worked effectively with frontend, AI and business teams
* Contributed to better technical documentation and development standards
* Helped create a stronger and more scalable technology foundation for GCRS

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing international business where technology is increasingly important to how we operate and deliver services.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful internal and client\-facing technology projects and contribute directly to the development of systems that support an international regulatory business.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person
